name: Source tax on a BVG annuity and lump sum paid abroad, from Lugano, in a plan in euros
workings: Plan in euros at 0.93 CHF/EUR: the annuity is EUR 20,000.00 = CHF 18,600.00, the lump sum EUR 500,000.00 = CHF 465,000.00. Canton Ticino, commune Lugano (80%).
Annuity: federal 1% = CHF 186.0000; Ticino 9% cantonal and communal = CHF 1,674.0000.
Lump sum, federal: 1/5 of the tariff on 465,000 = CHF 9,576.6880.

Lump sum, Ticino (art. 38): the annuity it buys at the average factor (50.77 + 46.67) / 2 = 48.72 per 1,000 is 22,654.80, rounded down to 22,600; the tariff's average rate there is 2.430301% (between the 2% floor and the 3% cap); simple tax 11,300.899115; x (100% + 80%) = CHF 20,341.618407.
